description:
Read the newest engine events (saves, plays, op results, script errors, imports) at once, and next_seq, the cursor to pass to summer_wait_for_event.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/recent-events"}

kinds.description: Event kinds to deliver (default: all). v1 kinds: op.applied, op.failed, script.error, play.started, play.stopped, scene.saved, scene.opened, import.completed, selection.changed, snapshot.published.

since.description: Deliver events with seq > since. Omit = the newest `limit` sequence numbers. 0 = the whole retained ring from the oldest (paged: pass next_seq back while truncated is true).

name: summer_recent_events
title: Read recent engine events
